cohort: 114 pregnant women with a singleton pregnancy
finding: While Apgar scores and birth weight were similar between groups, women with low first trimester PAPP-A had a significantly higher frequency of complications like premature birth, preeclampsia, and SGA.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was similar between the groups (29.7% in the low PAPP-A group vs 32% in the control group), but there was a significant difference in elective vs urgent cesarean section, favoring the low PAPP-A group.
